title: Algerian Chicken Tagine
description: A hearty and aromatic Algerian chicken tagine stew made with chicken, vegetables, and spices.

ingredients.name: quick tagine spice mix
ingredients.notes: available at most spice stores or online

ingredients.name: algerian fix spices
ingredients.notes: available at most spice stores or online

instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the tagine spice mix and stir to combine.
Add the petit pois, chicken broth, and fix spices. Stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
